limitations: This packet is a screened source-set excerpt, not a complete global inventory.
Point and editorial state locators do not establish whole-feature physical containment.
Scientific claims and public release remain under review.

geometries.method: Editorial northern Papua New Guinea coastal point near the mooring study region; not a dated surface-current centerline or endpoint.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: Three years of moorings distinguish this upper-100 m current from the deeper New Guinea Coastal Undercurrent: it flows southeastward in boreal winter and northwestward in boreal summer. The observations do not define a whole-current alongflow length.
